text:
maya (Design): Heads-up: I'm prototyping a sidebar regroup that lumps 'Models' + 'Deployments' into a single cluster. Two labels on the table: 'Workloads' (explicit) or 'Workspace' (friendlier). Need quick opinions + routing implications.

sam (Frontend): I prefer 'Workloads' for clarity. Router-wise let's keep routes simple: `/workspace/:id/model/:modelId` and accept `?view=compact` and `?navMode=icons` as optional overrides. Fallback behaviour: missing modelId -> list view; bad id -> redirect to /workspace with toast.

jonah (PM): Support asked permalinks to preserve UI state. Agreed on query params, not cookies. Also need canonical breadcrumb pattern for copy and help docs: `Workloads / Models / <name>` if we pick 'Workloads'.

kevin (A11y): A11y checklist: 1) last breadcrumb gets `aria-current="page"`; 2) separators `aria-hidden="true"`; 3) truncated names use `aria-label` with full string (avoid title-only tooltips); 4) announce nav mode changes in an `aria-live="polite"` region (e.g., "Navigation collapsed"); 5) ensure 44px tappable targets and `aria-expanded` on group buttons.

maya (Design): UX tweak: ditch the `+` in favor of a chevron + accessible label (Expand/Collapse). Also poll for density: :thumbsup: = icons-only compact, :raised_hand: = icons+mini-label.

sam (Frontend): Implementation note: make the whole row a button, keep `aria-controls` pointing to the list element, and expose `?navMode=compact` for demos. Router should normalize duplicate slashes and preserve `view`/`navMode` when following permalinks. Example component snippet: `<button aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"wkl-list\">Workloads <span class=chev/></button>`.

navbot (deploy-bot): branch `nav-compact-experiments` deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.internal/nav-test (build 2026.03.22-9).

maya (Design): Action items: 1) try staging + quick SR pass, 2) validate skiplink target text "Skip to main navigation", 3) check breadcrumb contrast for AA, 4) verify permalinks include view param. If no strong objections by EOD Friday we'll ship with label 'Workloads' and the accessibility tweaks. :sparkles:
